claim: 你一生走得穩不穩，關鍵在意志堅不堅定；意志一軟，不少困擾就由自己的一念而起。
en: How steadily your life goes depends on how firm your will is; when it softens, many of your troubles start from a single thought of your own.
limit: 原文以意志堅強抑或薄弱分此星系。原文標題 PDF 誤作「太陽」，正文為太陰（見 deep/REVIEW.md）。

claim: 你的盤意志偏堅強：你有定力，不容易被感情或物欲牽著走。
en: Your chart leans strong-willed: you have staying power and are not easily led by feelings or material wants.

claim: 你的盤意志偏軟：你容易被感情或物欲牽著走。
en: Your chart leans soft-willed: you are easily led by feelings or by wants.

claim: 你在感情上意志較軟，容易心軟。
en: Where feelings are concerned your will is softer, and you are easily moved.

claim: 你在錢財物質上容易動搖，投資決定較易出錯。
en: You waver easily over money and possessions, and your investment decisions are more prone to error.
limit: 原文另說太陰化忌主六親無緣，不寫。

claim: 你適合管理錢財，或掌握財政上的權責。
en: You are suited to managing money or holding financial responsibility.
limit: 原文：太陰化權仅主理財或司財賦權柄，縱能富亦由此而來；化權也增加意志力。

claim: 你對自己約束較嚴，但容易陷於孤立。
en: You hold yourself to strict discipline, but this can leave you isolated.
limit: 原文：天梁有刑曜同度，入廟太陰會照，增加自我克制，亦增強意志力，但易陷於孤立。刑曜以天刑計。

claim: 你和親近的人容易冷熱不調。
en: Things with the people closest to you easily run hot and cold.
limit: 原文「六親冰炭」，另說早年不利父母、婚姻子女不如意，不寫事件；意志反而變得薄弱一句未寫（免與偏向相反）。刑曜以天刑計。

claim: 你容易耽於享樂或物欲。
en: You can sink too easily into pleasure or material wants.

claim: 你本性收斂，收得太過就容易消沉。
en: You are reserved by nature, and too much holding in can turn into low spirits.
limit: 原文：太陰收斂太過則主消沉，不喜陀羅、鈴星、化忌、陰煞、空劫、天刑等，尤以卯酉為然；陰煞、天空引擎冇，未計；刑耗齊湊的極端克應不寫。

claim: 你的路走得較為辛苦。
en: Your road is harder going than most.

claim: 你的盤成了富局，有條件累積可觀的財富。
en: Your chart forms a pattern of wealth, giving you the means to build up considerable riches.
limit: 原文：卯酉太陰酉優於卯甚多；唯卯宮見輔佐諸吉、不見煞、又見吉化，則為反背，主大富。不寫金額。反背按本星系原文條件定義（A6，2026-10-19）。

claim: {decades}這段時間，是你一生運程的樞紐。
en: The years {decades} are the hinges of your life course.
limit: 原文：巨門、廉相、七殺、天機宮垣為大運流年之樞紐；反背者不論天機。

claim: 這十年對你相宜。
en: This decade suits you.

claim: 這十年想改變環境，要先深思熟慮。
en: If you want to change your situation this decade, think it through carefully first.
limit: 「見化忌」以殺破狼三方四正見本命化忌或大限化忌入大限三方四正計。

claim: 這十年容易往壞的方向轉變，宜守成，也不宜陷入感情糾纏。
en: This decade things can turn for the worse; hold what you have and stay out of emotional entanglements.

claim: 這十年以守成為佳。
en: This decade is best spent consolidating.

claim: 這十年對你是一段險運。
en: This decade is a risky stretch for you.

claim: 這十年感情上容易受較大的挫折，也容易惹上口舌是非。
en: This decade can bring a bigger setback in love, and gossip or quarrels too.

claim: 這十年是你開運的時候。
en: This decade opens up your fortunes.

claim: 這十年往往是你開運的時候。
en: This decade often opens up your fortunes.

claim: 這十年容易因感情用事而受挫，或因感情挫折受到重大打擊。
en: This decade acting on emotion can trip you up, or a setback in love can hit you hard.
limit: 原文另說更見昌曲化忌的極端情況，不寫。

claim: 這十年是你得意的時候，但要防得意忘形。
en: This decade is a high point for you, but guard against getting carried away.

claim: 這十年對你有利，容易得人相助成事。
en: This decade favours you, and others readily help you succeed.

claim: 這十年處事要謹慎，免得惹上是非。
en: Act carefully this decade so you do not get drawn into disputes.

claim: 這十年你內心多矛盾，容易進退失據。
en: This decade you are torn inside and may not know whether to advance or retreat.

claim: 這一年容易受人拖累而破財。
en: This year you are liable to lose money by being dragged into others' troubles.
limit: 原文：天梁運限吉少煞多，更見太陽太陰化忌會照，是年主受拖累致破財；此星系太陽、太陰必在天梁三方四正。女命一句不寫。

claim: 這十年容易因感情用事而失敗，或受流言影響而失去鬥志。
en: This decade acting on emotion can lead to failure, or rumours can sap your drive.

claim: 這十年你不至於退縮，但多受滋擾。
en: This decade you will not back down, but you face plenty of disturbance.

claim: 這十年積極進取，對你有利。
en: This decade is a time to push forward, and it works in your favour.

claim: 這十年有機會大有發展。
en: This decade gives you a chance to grow considerably.

claim: 這十年也算順遂。
en: This decade goes reasonably smoothly.

claim: 這十年容易因決定錯誤而招來損失。
en: This decade a wrong decision can cost you.

claim: 這十年對你有利。
en: This decade works in your favour.

claim: 這十年對你不利。
en: This decade works against you.

claim: 這十年即使形勢好，你也只是少些困擾，未必能大展拳腳。
en: Even when conditions are good this decade, it mostly means fewer worries for you rather than a big leap.

claim: 這十年形勢即使不佳，你也能保住已有的。
en: Even if conditions are poor this decade, you can hold on to what you have.

claim: 這十年你能順應形勢而有所作為。
en: This decade you can go with the tide and get things done.

claim: 這十年機會太多反易失機；腳踏實地、靜心觀察，才把握得住。
en: This decade too many chances can make you miss them all; stay grounded and watch calmly to seize the right one.

claim: 這十年有好的轉變，對之後的運也有好影響。
en: This decade brings a good change that also lifts the years after it.

claim: 這十年只利於計劃籌謀。
en: This decade is good only for planning and preparation.

claim: 這十年對你有利。
en: This decade works in your favour.

claim: 這十年往往是你一生事業奠基的時候。
en: This decade is often when you lay the foundation of your life's work.

claim: 這十年對你不利，只宜不理是非、不跟人惡性競爭，我行我素以求平穩。
en: This decade works against you; it is best to stay out of disputes, avoid cut-throat competition, and go your own way to keep things steady.

claim: 這十年越想變化，越容易陷入困境。
en: This decade, the more you try to change things, the deeper into difficulty you get.
limit: 原文「煞曜重」，以大限命宮三方四正見兩煞或以上計。

claim: 這十年適合打基礎，但不可心高氣傲。
en: This decade is for laying foundations, but do not let pride run ahead of you.

claim: 這十年你心情容易矛盾。
en: This decade your feelings may pull you in two directions.

claim: 這十年有機會獨當一面，受人信任。
en: This decade gives you a chance to take charge on your own and be trusted.
limit: 原文另說見魁鉞尤吉、輔弼次之；大運化科見昌曲利考試，未寫。

claim: 這一年要防感情上的重大挫折，以及因此而來的錢財損失。
en: This year guard against a major setback in love and the money losses that may follow.
limit: 原文：流年紫府見廉貞化忌及武曲化忌同時會照。
